verses.1: And write to the messenger from the church in Sardis: “Thus says he who has seven spirits of God and seven stars. You know that you have a name, but you still live, yet you are dead.”
verses.2: Be quick, and help me complete the remaining tasks I still have to finish. For I do not want your work to be left unfinished before my God.
verses.3: I remember how you heard and understood everything. So, may you repent. If you don’t do so soon, I will come as a thief, and I won’t know what time I will come to you.
verses.4: But you have a few names in Sardis that do not tarnish their reputations. They will walk among us in white, because they are truly worthy.
verses.5: The winner is surrounded by white garments in such a manner. I will not hide his name from the book of life. I will also declare his name before my father and before his angels.
verses.6: He who has those ears to hear, what does the Spirit say to the churches?
verses.7: And write to the messenger from the church in Philadelphia: “Thus says the holy one, the true one, who has the key of David; he opens and no one can close, and closes and no one can open.”
verses.8: Do you know what those works are? I have placed before your eyes a ladder that no one can climb up onto. You know that you have little strength to do anything. But you have understood my words, and I will not deny my name.
verses.9: I will make them come forward from among those who claim to be Jews, but in reality they are not true Jews at all—they’re just deceivers. I will make them come forward so that they can worship before your feet. Then they will realize that I love you.
verses.10: Since you have endured my patience, I too will endure from now on the trials that will come upon our home. I will try to test those who live here on earth.
verses.11: I’m coming quickly. I hope you have what you need, so that no one can take your crown away from you.
verses.12: I will make him a statue in the temple of my God. He shall not be allowed to leave that temple ever again. I will also write on him the name of my God and the name of my new city, Jerusalem. It will be a city that rises from heaven, by my God’s power. And it will bear my name.
verses.13: He who has those qualities, as I will hear, says what the Spirit says in the churches.
verses.14: And write also to the messenger from the church in Laodicea: “Thus says Ammin, the faithful and true witness. This is the beginning of the creation of God.”
verses.15: Do you know what the properties of it are? It’s neither cold nor hot. It’s either cold or hot, depending on the conditions.
verses.16: So, since you’re neither hot nor cold, I will pour it out from my mouth.
verses.17: Because you say that I am rich, and that I have nothing to do with wealth. But you don’t know that you yourself are poor, humble, blind, and naked.
verses.18: I advise you to get gold that has been heated in fire, so that you can become rich. Also, wear white clothes, so that your nudity isn’t visible. And put glasses on your eyes, so that you can see clearly.
verses.19: I, when I love someone, always examine and educate myself about that person. So, be jealous and repent.
verses.20: I stand at the door, and I knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will enter and eat with him, and he will eat with me.
verses.21: I will give him the honor of sitting with me in my throne, just as I once sat with my father in his throne.
verses.22: He who has those ears to hear, what does the Spirit say to the churches?
